programmes.name: Connect to Work
programmes.description: A voluntary, locally commissioned Supported Employment programme supporting disabled people, people with health conditions and people with complex barriers to employment to find or retain sustainable work.

programmes.name: Economic Inactivity Trailblazers
programmes.description: Nine place-based trailblazers testing locally led, integrated work, health and skills support for people who are economically inactive.

programmes.name: Future Employment Support
programmes.description: Future employment-support commissioning intelligence, including public procurement, geography, supply-chain and workforce signals as they become available.

programmes.name: Restart Scheme
programmes.description: DWP employment support programme providing tailored and intensive support to eligible Universal Credit claimants to help them achieve sustained work.

programmes.name: WorkWell
programmes.description: An integrated early-intervention work and health support service providing light-touch, holistic support for people with health-related barriers to employment, delivered through Integrated Care Board partnerships.

programmes.name: Youth Guarantee Trailblazers
programmes.description: Eight place-based Youth Guarantee Trailblazers testing locally led support for young people who are NEET or at risk of becoming NEET, linking employment, education, training and wider support.

notes: This is the curated public Programme Intelligence payload.

The validated frontend export is the publication gate; programme payloads may be enriched with separately curated public canonical records and publishable procurement facts from the same CareerPath engine.
